name: faf001_CompleteTask
description: Atomically complete an assigned open task, save widget outputs and complete its linked human-task step. Requires a synchronous transaction.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_CompleteTask.faf001_SubmissionJson
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: JSON object with integer outcome, optional string notes, and optional values array of key/type/value objects. Outcomes: 324010000..324010002. Types: text, json, number, boolean, datetime.

CustomAPIResponseProperties.name: faf001_CompleteTask.faf001_StepId
CustomAPIResponseProperties.description: GUID of the existing linked human-task step that was completed. Repeated completion is rejected.
